integrity: The proof derives a complete necessary-and-sufficient isomorphism condition from the monomial form of isomorphisms, reduces it to one multiplicative quotient invariant, uses Burnside's lemma for the exact class count, and separately derives automorphism and idempotent formulas. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies the classification on several complete coefficient spaces, including extension-field orders through their cyclic multiplicative groups.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for one connected directed cycle with all edge coefficients nonzero.
Multi-cycle permutation evolution algebras require an additional permutation-of-components layer.
General monomial rigidity and graph-automorphism structure are prior results; the contribution is the explicit finite-field orbit classification, enumeration, stabilizers, and idempotent boundary.
title: Weighted cycle evolution algebras over finite fields are doubling-orbit classified
